subject: general
question: What is the other name of Bharathapuzha, the second longest river of Kerala, which flows from the west and falls into the Arabian Sea?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ponnani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bharathapuzha is also known as** River Nila** or **River Ponnani**.
 
• Bharathapuzha is the **second longest river** in Kerala, flowing for a distance of **209 km**.
 
• It originates from the **Anamalai hills** in Tamil Nadu and flows through **Palakkad district** before draining into the Arabian Sea.
 
• Bharathapuzha is **250 km** long in total, of which 41 km stretch along Tamil Nadu, its source state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ittikkara:**

 
 
• Ittikara river is situated in **Kollam district** in kerala.
 
• The origin of itthikara river is from the low hills situated near** Madthuri Kunnu **at about +240m above M.S.L. 
 
 
 
• **Ayiroor:**
 
 
• It lies in the western portion of **Ranni taluk**, in the **Pathanamthitta district** of Kerala state, India,which is close to Thiruvalla.
 
• Ayiroor is situated along the **Ayiroorpuzha river,** which is among the tiniest rivers in Kerala, second only to the **Manjeshwaram puzha.**
 
 
 
• **Kallayi:** 
 
 
• This river is in Kerala.
 
• Its starting point is at an elevation of 45 meters (148 feet) in** Cherikkulathur**, in the Western Ghats.
 
• Its length is** 22** kilometers.
